market_summary: U.S. equities are trying to rebound on June 29, 2026 after reports that the U.S. and Iran agreed to halt attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, with futures and VIX showing relief. The setup is not broad risk-on: recent Nasdaq and AI weakness, small-cap lag, jobs-data risk later this week, and plateauing breadth argue for conditional longs only in liquid names with relative strength.

market_thesis.primary_swing_theory: Over the next 2-10 trading days, the market can stabilize if geopolitical de-escalation keeps oil and volatility contained, but leadership should remain selective until QQQ and breadth repair the recent tech selloff.
drivers: U.S.-Iran de-escalation and lower headline pressure around the Strait of Hormuz
VIX near the high teens rather than panic levels
Holiday-shortened week with Thursday jobs data as the next macro checkpoint
Selective strength in high-liquidity premarket movers rather than broad sector confirmation
what_would_change_my_mind: QQQ continues to underperform SPY and loses the opening range while VIX rises back toward 20
IWM and sector breadth fail to participate in the relief bounce
Jobs or inflation expectations push yields higher and renew pressure on growth stocks
Watchlist candidates fail VWAP/opening-range confirmation after the first hour
market_thesis.crowding_assessment: medium: the relief narrative is obvious after the U.S.-Iran headlines, and the cleanest movers are already visible in premarket screens, so entry quality matters more than headline direction.

regime_scorecard.rule: risk_on requires at least 5 bullish factors and no more than 1 bearish factor; otherwise use neutral/risk_off.

sp500_trend.evidence: StreetStats showed the S&P 500 near its 50-day average at 7354.02 versus a 50-day average of 7363.43, above the 200-day but with neutral RSI; finance quote showed SPY slightly lower at 728.99 during premarket.

qqq_trend.evidence: IBD/Barron's described recent Nasdaq weakness and a sharp tech pullback; finance quote showed QQQ down 1.35% at 706.52.

small_cap_breadth.evidence: Investing.com premarket data showed IWM lagging at -0.16% while QQQ/SPY futures were higher; finance quote showed IWM slightly lower at 299.83.

vix_direction.evidence: Yahoo/MarketWatch/Investing.com showed VIX around 18.4-18.6, down versus the prior 19.7 area.

ten_year_yield.evidence: Kapitales market summary reported the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield declined for a fourth straight session to 4.37%, its lowest since May 8.

sector_breadth.evidence: Yahoo sector and Schwab calendar sources did not provide a clean real-time sector-leadership read; available evidence showed stock-specific movers rather than broad sector confirmation.

candidate_relative_strength.evidence: Premarket sources showed CMCSA/CHTR/PLTR among active gainers, and finance quote showed PLTR up 5.2% and AVAV up 1.0% before the open.

headline_risk.evidence: U.S.-Iran de-escalation reduced immediate oil/geopolitical risk, but Thursday jobs data and Fed-rate expectations remain unresolved macro risks.
